# Walter Brennan — Major Donor (Anonymous)

- **Relationship:** long-time major individual donor; **external.**
- **Giving:** gives a **~$75,000/year unrestricted gift**, most recently a spring 2026 gift Cam
  still owes thanks for (see [commitments](../commitments.md)).
- **Relationship owner:** [Daniela Cruz](daniela-cruz.md), with Cam personally.

## Stewardship — strict, honor exactly
- **He must be thanked by a handwritten note only — never a form email, never a template.** A
  generic acknowledgment offends him.
- **He gives anonymously: never name him publicly, never list him in any donor honor roll,
  annual-report donor list, gala program, or press.** Anonymity is non-negotiable.
- Keep his file and any recognition scrubbed of his name in public-facing materials.

## Notes
- Quiet, private, values the mission over the spotlight. A leak of his name would likely end the
  relationship.
- Not connected to the confidential [Willow](../projects/willow.md) matter — a different donor.
